cards.description: Distinct assets in the selected region, 24–30 Sep 2026.
Review flags: <90% completeness or >2% invalid intervals, 24–30 Sep 2026.

query.sql:
-- One record per synthetic asset per day; all assets expect 96 intervals/day.
CREATE VIEW daily_metrics AS
SELECT day, region, SUM(expected) AS expected, SUM(received) AS received,
       SUM(invalid) AS invalid, SUM(incident) AS incidents,
       1.0 * SUM(received) / SUM(expected) AS completeness,
       CASE WHEN SUM(received)=0 THEN NULL
            ELSE 1.0 * (SUM(received)-SUM(invalid))/SUM(received) END AS validity
FROM readings GROUP BY day, region;

CREATE VIEW recent_metrics AS
SELECT region, COUNT(DISTINCT asset_id) AS assets,
       SUM(expected) AS expected, SUM(received) AS received,
       SUM(invalid) AS invalid, SUM(incident) AS incident_days,
       1.0 * SUM(received) / SUM(expected) AS completeness,
       CASE WHEN SUM(received)=0 THEN NULL
            ELSE 1.0*(SUM(received)-SUM(invalid))/SUM(received) END AS validity
FROM readings WHERE day BETWEEN '2026-09-24' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY region;

CREATE VIEW provider_metrics AS
SELECT region, provider, SUM(expected) AS expected, SUM(received) AS received,
       1.0*SUM(received)/SUM(expected) AS completeness
FROM readings WHERE day BETWEEN '2026-09-24' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY region, provider;

blocks.body:
# Operations Analytics Dashboard

Synthetic portfolio demo. Last complete day: **30 Sep 2026**. KPI cards cover **24–30 Sep**; the trend covers 90 days. Select a region to investigate coverage and data quality.

## Definitions and limits

**Completeness:** received ÷ expected intervals (96 per asset-day). **Validity:** valid ÷ received intervals. **Flags:** asset-days below 90% completeness or above 2% invalid intervals. Flags require investigation; they do not diagnose equipment failures. The same rule is applied to every provider.

All assets, providers and readings are fictional. The South/Beta outage is deliberately injected. This is a fixed snapshot, with no live connection or refresh. Python regenerates data and snapshot JSON; this HTML is the reviewed presentation.
